execution.reason: Root retained the build token for the running final full suite; the formal reviewer must personally execute all required gates.

evidence_summary: The implementation keeps the finite product-set solver private and compiler-independent, owns one Arch_index_cfa_cmt session per CMT, finalizes after authoritative root/literal storage notifications, and shares deferred expansion between main and flat producers. Main and flat retain separate representability policy, which matches the contract rather than duplicating identity claims. The remaining findings concern enforcement and extensibility at private module boundaries, not a claim that current acceptance tests fail.

findings.summary: The session's finalized state is enforced by only some mutating entry points
findings.evidence: register_local_alias and register_call reject a finalized session at lines 199-200 and 267-268, but observe_literal, notify_stored_literal, notify_stored_root, notify_rejected_root, fresh_owner, register_local_expr, and register_expr_call remain callable after finalize. Several of those mutate literal state, owner allocation, cells, constraints, or target/reason seeds after the sole solve at lines 290-317. value_of_call then accepts the finalized flag and can expose an unsolved or partially mutated session. Current main and flat orchestration finalize last, but the private interface itself does not preserve that lifecycle invariant, and stage-3 argument/return/capture callbacks will increase the number of mutation paths.
findings.risk: Current main and flat orchestration obey finalize-last, so this is not a demonstrated current AC violation. A future integration call added after finalization can silently create stale closure results instead of failing at the ownership boundary.
findings.fix: Centralize an ensure_open guard and invoke it from every mutator/owner allocator, or split collection and finalized-query states into distinct abstract types so post-finalization mutation is unrepresentable.

findings.summary: Semantic unknown-reason kinds are represented as unrestricted strings and mapped with a catch-all
findings.evidence: Both target identities and semantic reason kinds use the same String_set representation at arch_index_cfa.ml:1-3. Producers seed string literals such as callback_param and dropped_node, while arch_index_cmt.ml:686-688 maps only dropped_node explicitly and silently converts every other value—including a typo or a future stage-3 reason—to Callback_param. The validated contract says reason kinds are semantic and independent, not diagnostic witnesses (FR-008/C-18), and defines a closed persistence mapping (FR-036).
findings.risk: A misspelled or newly introduced semantic reason compiles, participates in closure as a distinct value, then is silently collapsed at persistence. This obscures ownership/capture distinctions and makes stage-3 extension non-exhaustive.
findings.fix: Give reasons a private variant and a dedicated ordered set; expose an exhaustive conversion to existing top_reason values at the integration boundary. Keep targets as strings if canonical stored names remain their intended identity.

findings.summary: Root and same-callable expression transfer duplicate the stage-2 expression grammar
findings.evidence: root_expr_cell at lines 83-101 and expr_cell/build at lines 221-259 independently encode Pident copying, if/match joins, sequence-result selection, function literals, and opaque fallback. Their ownership and literal-authentication policies differ legitimately, but their syntax dispatch is duplicated inside a 336-line module; create itself spans roughly 95 lines. Any stage-3 addition to returned values, arguments, or captures would need coordinated edits in both walkers and could create root/local semantic drift.
findings.risk: The next roadmap stage can accidentally support an expression form in one ownership context but not the other, despite both being described as one CFA transfer model.
findings.fix: Extract one internal expression-transfer walker parameterized by source-ownership lookup and literal-cell policy. Preserve the deliberate root-versus-callable policy in those callbacks rather than duplicating the Typedtree cases.

non_findings: The copied kernel in test/dune is the exact production source, not a second solver implementation; the independent repeated-scan oracle remains in test code.
Separate flat representability checks are contract-required policy and do not duplicate main identity ownership.
Deferred CFA tokens and __cfa:expanded markers remain private and are cleared before persistence.
No schema or public embedding API was added, and the implementation does not structurally introduce stage-3 transfer.
